say:2:1510735001:0.text: Bey, take your child and leave for Wrathwood Grove. The Halians have sent armies marching into the forest. A battle is coming.
say:2:1510735001:0.source_cn: 碧，带着你的孩子离开，呼临军队潜入了丛林，即将开战。

say:3:1510735002:0.text: What? No! Moonpaw, my child—she's old enough to serve the tribe!
say:3:1510735002:0.source_cn: 什么？不，卓，这孩子——她到了该为部落效力的年纪了！

say:5:1510735003:0.text: I... I want to protect everyone, too!

choice_prompt:6:1510735006.text: May the Wild Moon light your path, Nazrik, Gala!
choice_prompt:6:1510735006.source_cn: 愿雅库伯尔之月照耀你们，那非，加拉！

say:9:1510735004:0.text: This is a divine order. Move to Wrathwood Grove. Toro will send people to escort you.
say:9:1510735004:0.source_cn: 这是神谕。转移到树怒山谷，都罗会派人护送你们。

say:10:1510735005:0.text: ... Fine. I'll take Moonpaw and leave.

say:13:1510735006:0.text: May the Wild Moon light your path, Nazrik, Gala!
say:13:1510735006:0.source_cn: 愿雅库伯尔之月照耀你们，那非，加拉！

choice:6:0:1.text: Give me a break, she's younger than Gala.
choice:6:0:1.male: Give me a break, she's younger than Gala.
choice:6:0:1.female: Give me a break, she's younger than Gala.

choice:6:1:2.text: Protecting yourself is the best way to help.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 保护好自己就是在帮大家
choice:6:1:2.male: Protecting yourself is the best way to help.
choice:6:1:2.female: Protecting yourself is the best way to help.

choice:6:2:3.text: There'll be plenty of other chances. For now, run!
choice:6:2:3.male: There'll be plenty of other chances. For now, run!
choice:6:2:3.female: There'll be plenty of other chances. For now, run!
